articles.summary: For the Hamilton City Fire Department in Alabama, readiness starts with taking care of its people and making sure they have the equipment, information, and support they need to do their jobs safely. With 12 career and 14 volunteer firefighters serving the Hamilton community, the department relies on technology to help its crews stay ready, keep equipment in service and manage critical information — whether they’re at the station or miles away. articles.title: Hamilton Fire: Protecting Our People Starts With Being Ready
